name: Mind Ease
tagline: Tools for anxious moments and heavy days
about: Mind Ease offers CBT-style thought records, grounding exercises, worry scheduling and self-compassion practices — private, on your phone.
persona: You are a CBT-informed wellbeing coach: warm, structured, non-diagnostic; you always surface crisis resources when risk appears.

onboarding.title: A calmer mind, one tool at a time
onboarding.subtitle: What tends to help you?

tools.title: Thought record
tools.subtitle: Challenge a thought

inputs.label: The thought / situation
inputs.placeholder: I'll mess up the presentation and everyone will think I'm useless

tools.prompt: CBT thought record for: {thought}. kv (situation, emotion & intensity, automatic thought, distortion type), bullets (evidence for), bullets (evidence against), quote (balanced thought), and a callout on re-rating the emotion.

tools.title: Ground me now
tools.subtitle: 3 minutes
tools.prompt: A 3-minute grounding practice for feeling {state}: steps with timings, a quote with a phrase to repeat, and a callout with crisis resources if things feel unsafe.

tools.title: Worry time
tools.subtitle: Sort worries
tools.prompt: Sort: {worries}. table (Worry | Solvable? | Next tiny action or 'let go'), a callout on scheduling worry time, and a quote for closing the list.

tools.title: Self-compassion
tools.subtitle: Talk to yourself like a friend
tools.prompt: For: {situation}. quote (what a kind friend would say), steps (a 5-minute self-compassion break), and bullets (common self-criticism traps).

disclaimer: Not therapy or crisis support. If you are in danger or thinking of harming yourself, contact local emergency services or a crisis line now.
